title: Warm Charred Fish Bowl
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Portuguese-inspired fish dish, served in a warm and charred bowl.
instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt, black pepper, and chili flakes (if using).
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pan over medium heat.
Sear the fish fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the warm charred bowl by placing it in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until warmed through.
Remove the bowl from the oven and place the cooked fish fillets on top.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the fish and sprinkle with minced garlic.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Serve the fish in the warm charred bowl, with additional lemon wedges on the side (if desired).
